extraction_limitations: Extraction is model-generated and has not been independently human-verified; all atoms are marked needs_review.

The extraction prioritizes independently reviewable study objectives, methods, benchmark construction, central quantitative results, application results, limitations, funding, and availability statements; it does not atomize every citation or every cell in every table.
Plot values from Figures 2, 4, and 5 were not exhaustively digitized; figure-derived atoms preserve only claims explicitly stated in nearby text or directly legible qualitative patterns.
Detailed prompt taxonomy entries in Appendix D were not exhaustively converted into one atom per checklist item.
No external/web verification was performed; the uploaded primary source and governing @ATOM project sources were used.
